note: The scripts and stylesheets a browser loads at start (index.html), each with what the start needs it for. Code that belongs to one screen or panel loads on its first use instead (docs/context/web.md, Code loads where it is used): a file missing here fails gates/on-use.spec.mjs until it is loaded on use, or listed with its reason. designs/<design>: the chosen design's own files.

files.tokens.css: the design tokens every screen reads
files.base.css: element defaults and the shell's frame
files.components.css: the shared components on every screen: cards, rows, buttons, dialogs, popovers
files.screens/now.css: the player bar and the Now Playing column, on every screen
files.screens/library.css: the song lists and cards every list screen, Home included, is built from
files.screens/system.css: service banners, the command palette, the pairing gate and the Connect picker, on any screen; and Settings
files.designs/<design>/theme.css: the chosen design, before the first paint
files.designs/designs.js: designs and their slots, before the first paint
files.data.js: the API client and the reads every screen makes
files.align.js: the player's switch to a better copy mid-song
files.eq.js: the device's equaliser, applied from the first song
files.player-rules.js: the player's rules, which the player follows from the first song
files.app.js: the router, the shell and the player
files.connect.js: lull Connect: this device reports what it plays, and takes commands, from the start
files.offline.js: downloads, and their covers without the hub
files.screens/now.js: the player bar and Now Playing
files.screens/library.js: the library's screens and the song rows shared across the app
files.screens/appearance.js: a stored theme reloads live when the hub changes it (server events); and Settings > Appearance
files.screens/setup.js: the pairing gate, which opens before anything else works, and library.source events
files.screens/system.js: service banners, the command palette, shortcuts, install and update; and Settings
